description: This PHP file contains functions related to handling the rescheduling history of calls within the SuiteCRM module, including generating HTML representations of reschedule logs and counting reschedules for a specific call.

methods.name: reschedule_history
methods.description: Generates an HTML list showing the rescheduling history for a call, including reasons and timestamps, for the DetailView page.

methods.name: reschedule_count
methods.description: Counts the total number of reschedules associated with a particular call and updates the call's reschedule_count property.
